sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Self Care Gift Hamper for Her
sourceNotes.rawContent:
A pretty, thoughtfully packed gift hamper combining jewellery, indulgent treats, and a relaxing skincare treat. Beautifully packed in a kraft gift box with dried flower styling for a premium unboxing experience — perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, or a sweet surprise.
What's Inside:
- Crystal Drop Necklace & Earring Set (Gift Box Included)
- Satin Rose Hair Ties (Set of 2 – Pink & Ivory)
- Sunfeast Dark Fantasy Choco Fills
- Hershey's Kisses – Hazelnut 'n' Cookies
- Naliao Rose Oil Face Mask (Hydrating & Revitalizing)
Why She'll Love It:
- A complete gifting mix — jewellery, sweet treats & self-care
- Necklace & earring set comes in its own gift box, ready to wear or re-gift
- Ready-to-gift packaging, no extra wrapping needed
- Ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, or a "just because" surprise
Note: Cash on Delivery (COD) is not available for this hamper. Prepaid orders only.
